McuFreeNode.description: Free-list node of the first-fit 200-byte block pool. Word 0 is the size of the free region and word 1 is the next free node, or 0 for none (probably). Layout inferred from mcu_block200_alloc, which writes 0xFF8 to word 0 and 0 to word 1 at pool setup in build 0160.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Size in bytes of this free region (0xFF8 = 4088 at pool setup in build 0160).

fields.name: next
fields.description: Next free node, or 0 when this is the last one (probably).

XferQueueCtx.description: Context of the five-entry transfer queue, three words in build 0160. Set by mcu_xfer_queue_init and read by the sender mcu_0160_0800cdcc, which passes the configuration pointer to FUN_0800d10a.

fields.name: queue
fields.description: Address of the request table (XferReq x 5), set to 0x2000212C by mcu_xfer_queue_init.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of queue entries, 5 at init. Compared as the loop bound by the sender mcu_0160_0800cdcc.

fields.name: cfg
fields.description: Address of the control words at 0x200006F0 (xfer_ctrl_word0), passed to FUN_0800d10a by the sender.

XferReq.description: One transfer request record of 36 bytes (0x24), one per queue entry. FUN_0800d0e8 initialises each record from its arguments (mode 1, a 300-byte buffer, length 300, and 0). Field layout is not decoded here.

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: Raw 36-byte request record; sub-fields are not decoded yet.

McuMsgRecord.description: One message ring record of five 32-bit words, used by both message rings. The push functions copy the five words of the pushed record unchanged (probably a CAN-style message: header plus payload words). Meaning not confirmed.

fields.name: w0
fields.description: Word 0 of the record, the first word of the pushed record (probably the message header or identifier).

fields.name: w1
fields.description: Word 1 of the record, copied from the pushed record's word 1 (probably the message id or command).

fields.name: w2
fields.description: Word 2 of the record, copied from the pushed record's word 2 (probably payload).

fields.name: w3
fields.description: Word 3 of the record, copied from the pushed record's word 3 (probably payload).

fields.name: w4
fields.description: Word 4 of the record, copied from the pushed record's word 4 (probably payload or length).
